title: Pure Majestic Mech
summary: The three Majestic Mechs, with two untagged support cards, generic Rank 6 and Rank 8 Xyz, Links and staples. As the page says, the 2006 series has no searchers or Spells of its own, so this is a beatdown shell built to cash the Mechs in before their End Phase drawback. Majestic Mech - Ohka Normal Summons without tributing, and Majestic Mech - Goryu needs only one tribute. Either one sends itself to the GY in the End Phase if it was summoned that way. Double Summon gives you Ohka into Goryu in one turn. Soul of Purity and Light comes out free by banishing two LIGHT monsters, and the Mechs fill the GY for it. Ohka and Soul are both Level 6, so they make a Rank 6 Xyz before the End Phase. Dark Ceruvim Irisfil can then go over that Xyz for Rank 8. Archlord Kristya, Ultimate Offering and Beatrice, Lady of the Eternal, which the page also names, are Forbidden.
main: Level 6: Normal Summons without tributing; leaves in the End Phase.
Level 8: Tribute Summons with one tribute; pierces; leaves in the End Phase.
Level 4: draws on a direct hit; leaves in the End Phase.
Untagged Level 6 Fairy: summoned by banishing two LIGHT from the GY; Rank 6 with Ohka.
Untagged: a second Normal Summon for Ohka into Goryu or two Ohkas.
extra: Untagged Rank 6 from Ohka and Soul: destroys a monster per material.
Untagged Rank 6: negates a big monster on either turn.
Untagged Rank 6: revives a Level 5 or lower monster.
Untagged LIGHT Fairy Rank 8: can go over any Xyz you control.
